name: Benidorm 247
title: ESPAK United S.L. – importer of medical tools and equipments
paragraphs:
We provide creative solutions to clients in Europe and around the world,
creating things that get attention and meaningful.

We started our Industrial presence in 2005 from Sialkot, Pakistan as Manufacturer and Exporter of Beauty, Dental and Tools. now with our main Office in Spain, our Focus is on importing of Industrial Products manufactured by our Partners in Sialkot, Pakistan and selling them in Europe and throughout the world.

ESPAK is committed to partner up with small and medium Industry from Sialkot, Pakistan and promote them in Europe and throughout the world. With our presence in Spain, Europe with bridge up the communication and trust gap between the buyers and manufacturers.

We are well recognised in both Importer and Exporter communities. With our hardwork and efforts, we have earned the trust of well recognised importers/ sellers in Europe and have established Partnership Contracts with a number of small and medium buisnesses in Pakistan.
We import high quality products, manufactured by our partners in Pakistan and sell them in Europe.
